newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi King Fahd says the kingdom spent 15 billion riyals on water projects during the 1990-95 five-year plan.
- A South African agriculture delegation is to visit Saudi Arabia in September to boost cooperation.
- Yemen to reply soon on Saudi proposals over border dispute.
- The Saudi Cable Company posts a 9.8 million riyal profit in the first half of 1996.
- Transporation minister signs road maintenance contracts worth 11 million riyals.
- Saudi Arabia slaps ban on Belgian meat imports after reports that Belgian firms were allegedly re-exporting British beef with fake certificates of origin.
- Interior ministry detains a number of nationals and foreigners accused of bribery.
